datasets.name: Food-101
datasets.release: 2014 publication; archive revision/checksum not yet pinned
datasets.license_access_status: PENDING: primary landing page does not establish image-use/redistribution terms; archive agreement review required.

comparison.indian_food_relevance: Limited Indian coverage; general dish benchmark, not an Indian-meal validation set.
comparison.label_quality: Provider reports intentionally noisy training and manually reviewed test labels.
comparison.multi_food_support: Single image-level dish label; no verified component detection.
comparison.licensing_suitability: Conditional candidate; do not assign an open license without evidence.
comparison.annotation_consistency: Official labels/splits; original files and duplicates not inspected.
comparison.reproducibility: Official split reproducible after file hashes/version are pinned.
comparison.storage_feasibility: No full local download permitted; optional cloud benchmark only after rights/storage approval.
comparison.generalization_limits: Curated web photographs; mixed meals, hidden ingredients and Indian household distribution unvalidated.

datasets.name: Indian Food Images Dataset
datasets.license_access_status: BLOCKED: metadata licenseName is Other (specified in description); description identifies Google Images, without a clear rights grant.

comparison.indian_food_relevance: High topical relevance; regional coverage has not been audited.
comparison.label_quality: Class-folder labels reported; annotation review and quality not verified.
comparison.licensing_suitability: Not cleared for training or redistribution; user approval cannot supply third-party rights.
comparison.annotation_consistency: No source/session groups or recipe-level consistency established.
comparison.reproducibility: Version is identifiable; image hashes and release contents not inspected.
comparison.storage_feasibility: Metadata reports 376716405 bytes; expanded size unknown; no archive acquired.
comparison.generalization_limits: Small web collection; source overlap, regional bias, duplicate leakage and dish ambiguity unknown.

datasets.name: UECFOOD-256
datasets.release: Author project/paper; downloadable release not pinned
datasets.license_access_status: UNVERIFIED: original distribution inaccessible in this inspection; do not transfer FoodPix terms to a different dataset.

comparison.indian_food_relevance: Cuisine coverage for Indian meals not verified.
comparison.multi_food_support: Detection candidate; bounding-box format/coverage must be verified from original annotations.
comparison.segmentation_support: Do not treat boxes as masks.
comparison.annotation_consistency: Unverified; no claim about annotation counts.
comparison.reproducibility: Needs stable source release, checksum and grouped split evidence.
comparison.generalization_limits: Author FoodCam256 material describes world-food categories; target-domain validation absent.

datasets.name: FoodSeg103
datasets.release: MM 2021 base benchmark, not the FoodSeg154 extension
datasets.license_access_status: PARTIAL: repository/project Apache-2.0 statement verified; underlying image rights and redistribution scope not assumed from code license.

comparison.label_quality: Provider reports pixel-level ingredient annotations; no local audit.
comparison.multi_food_support: Multiple semantic regions per image; not instance identity.
comparison.segmentation_support: Semantic segmentation candidate only; no fabricated instances.
comparison.licensing_suitability: Archive/image terms need review before approval.
comparison.annotation_consistency: Resolve 103-name/104-README label/background convention from release metadata; do not conflate 154 extension.
comparison.reproducibility: Original zip/version hashes and splits still need pinning.
comparison.storage_feasibility: Official zip link available; size not verified; no download.
comparison.generalization_limits: Ingredient semantic labels do not establish dish/portion/instance accuracy.

datasets.name: UECFoodPixComplete
datasets.license_access_status: VERIFIED published restriction: non-commercial research only. Redistribution/model-distribution rights still require review.

comparison.indian_food_relevance: Listed classes appear Japan-oriented; Indian suitability is an assessment, not measured.
comparison.label_quality: Choose manual Complete release, not GrabCut-generated FoodPix.
comparison.multi_food_support: Multiple labeled food regions possible; instance identities not established.
comparison.segmentation_support: Semantic masks, red-channel IDs; table includes background/others/beverage.
comparison.licensing_suitability: Potential non-commercial research candidate; not automatically approved.
comparison.annotation_consistency: Original mask files/category counts/void labels must be audited.
comparison.reproducibility: Provider train/test lists; check shared originals with UEC variants before cross-dataset evaluation.
comparison.storage_feasibility: Provider reports 759 MB archive; extracted size unmeasured.
comparison.generalization_limits: Semantic regions are not separate physical portions or nutritional ground truth.

datasets.name: Nutrition5k
datasets.license_access_status: VERIFIED provider CC BY 4.0 link; attribution obligations apply; not acquired.

comparison.indian_food_relevance: Collected in California cafeterias; Indian generalization not established.
comparison.label_quality: Measured plate/ingredient data, not an audited dish-class taxonomy.
comparison.multi_food_support: Mixed plates with ingredient lists; do not infer localized objects.
comparison.segmentation_support: No instance-mask ground truth established by this inspection.
comparison.licensing_suitability: Clearer published data terms; still needs acquisition approval and permitted scope.
comparison.annotation_consistency: Group incremental scans and all views by plate; avoid frame leakage.
comparison.reproducibility: Official plate splits; exact file release/checksums not inspected.
comparison.storage_feasibility: 181.4 GB archive is incompatible with current disk; exclude from initial acquisition.
comparison.generalization_limits: Rig/cafeteria distribution; nutrition tasks belong to Phase 04, not this plan.

datasets.name: RASOI Challenge Dataset
datasets.release: provider metadata inspected 2026-11-01; corpus not acquired
datasets.license_access_status: Published CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, noncommercial research, mandatory creator attribution. Exact release, access and source-image governance require audit.

comparison.label_quality: Provider recipe labels and boxes; independent audit pending.
comparison.segmentation_support: Name alone does not establish masks.
comparison.licensing_suitability: Research candidate with stated restrictions; not approved.
comparison.annotation_consistency: Inspect standalone versus composite label policies.
comparison.reproducibility: University links a hashed Kaggle release; public metadata search returned no result.
comparison.storage_feasibility: Size unknown; cloud-only sample proposed after access clearance.
comparison.generalization_limits: Regional diversity and source independence unknown.

datasets.name: Indian Thali Dataset (ITD)
datasets.release: provider metadata inspected 2026-11-01; corpus not acquired
datasets.license_access_status: Dataset distribution/license unverified. The paper CC BY 4.0 notice is not treated as a separate archive license.

comparison.indian_food_relevance: Indian cafeteria thalis; high task relevance.
comparison.label_quality: Authors describe captured plates and dense annotations.
comparison.multi_food_support: Multiple foods and views; group all views by plate.
comparison.segmentation_support: Dense masks reported; instance encoding unverified.
comparison.annotation_consistency: Audit class IDs, mask format and plate lineage.
comparison.reproducibility: Requires pinned release and plate-disjoint split.
comparison.generalization_limits: One institutional capture setting; not nationwide household validation.

datasets.name: IndianFoodNet30
datasets.release: provider metadata inspected 2026-11-01; corpus not acquired
datasets.license_access_status: Hosted CC BY 4.0; original paper describes Google/Bing collection. Verify underlying image rights and original lineage before use.

comparison.label_quality: Paper reports model-assisted boxes with manual review.
comparison.multi_food_support: Detection labels; not single-label by assumption.
comparison.segmentation_support: Boxes are not semantic or instance masks.
comparison.annotation_consistency: Original versus derived labels/splits must reconcile.
comparison.reproducibility: Unaugmented originals and augmentation lineage needed.
comparison.storage_feasibility: Cloud sample only after rights approval; expanded size unknown.
comparison.generalization_limits: Do not count augmented derivatives as independent examples.

datasets.name: Khana
datasets.release: provider metadata inspected 2026-11-01; corpus not acquired
datasets.license_access_status: Author permits noncommercial research/education but explicitly disclaims image copyright ownership. Third-party rights remain unresolved.

comparison.indian_food_relevance: Broad Indian dish candidate, not exhaustive coverage.
comparison.segmentation_support: Paper task language does not verify mask release.
comparison.annotation_consistency: Verify taxonomy, background and duplicate conventions.
comparison.reproducibility: Need pinned files, checksums and source groups.
comparison.storage_feasibility: Full corpus cloud-only; no local archive.
comparison.generalization_limits: Web-image bias and shared-source leakage remain.

manual_evaluation_proposal.rights: team-owned food-only photographs; no faces, medical records or participant enrollment
manual_evaluation_proposal.annotation: two independent annotators with disagreement adjudication; session/meal groups; development and sealed final subsets
manual_evaluation_proposal.limitation: small challenge set; cannot establish broad Indian or reliable OOD performance
